page.overview:
Who is Roy Bromwell?

Roy Bromwell (ロイ・ブロムウェル Roi Buromuweru) is a fighting game character from the Rival Schools games.

Roy is capricious, sometimes less than serious, and tries more than anyone else just to look sharp. Nonetheless, he is a frank person who dislikes cowardice.

In the School Life Mode of Nekketsu Seisyun Nikki 2, Roy frequently shows and displays his coolness and attraction during the school events and also his elegant flaws whenever he shows his seriousness as well during both the Physical Education Day and in a theater play during the School Fair Day. It's also shown that when a female edit character befriends Roy, he is revealed to be quite very shy towards other women besides Tiffany while not admitting how bashful he was to them from within the process itself.

Roy has short blond hair with long fringes on both sides of his hair and two upper fringes in the center of his head. His outfit consists of a red formal vest under a longsleeve white buttoned shirt which is folded below to his mid-arm with a long red tie on the collar of his button shirt. He wears a black belt on his waist, denim pants, and black and red sneakers. He also wears black fingerless gloves and a silver watch on his left wrist.
